lines: To facilitate transition to e-Invoice, taxpayers can select the most suitable mechanism to transmit e-Invoices to IRBM, based on their business requirements and specific situation.
There are two (2) options for the e-Invoice transmission mechanisms for taxpayers selection:
Accessible to all taxpayers at no cost
Also accessible to taxpayers who need to issue e-Invoice where Application Programming Interface (API) connection is unavailable
An API is a set of programming code that enables direct data transmission between the taxpayers’ system and MyInvois system
Requires upfront investment in technology and adjustments to taxpayers existing systems
Ideal for large taxpayers or businesses with substantial transaction volumes

The figure below demonstrates an overview of the e-Invoice workflow from the point a sale is made or transaction is undertaken, and an e-Invoice is issued by the supplier via MyInvois Portal or API, up to the point of storing validated e-Invoices on IRBM’s database for taxpayers to view their respective historical e-Invoices.

pages.title: Garis Masa Pelaksanaan e-Invois
lines: e-Invoice will be implemented in phases to ensure smooth transition. The roll-out of e-Invoice has been planned with careful consideration, taking into account the turnover or revenue thresholds, to provide taxpayers with sufficient time to prepare and adapt to the e-Invoice implementation.
Below is the e-Invoice implementation timeline:
Taxpayers with an annual turnover or revenue of more than RM100 million 1 August 2024
Taxpayers with an annual turnover or revenue of more than RM25 million and up to RM100 million 1 January 2025
Taxpayers with an annual turnover or revenue of more than RM5 million and up to RM25 million 1 July 2025
Taxpayers with an annual turnover or revenue of up to RM5 million 1 January 2026
Taxpayers with an annual turnover or revenue of less than RM3,000,000 are exempted from e-Invoice implementation
Notes: e-Invoice implementation timeline been updated on 30 August 2026

lines: The MyInvois Portal is an e-invoicing solution provided by the HASiL at no charge. This platform is designed to facilitate the implementation of e-Invoice for all taxpayers especially for those who are not using the business ERP system to issue e-Invois. Accessible via computers, laptops, and tablets, the portal enables users to manage e-Invoice efficiently from anywhere, at any time.

In addition, taxpayers can also access via the MyInvois Application on their smartphones. The application can be downloaded from all official platforms, which are the App Store for iOS users, Google Play for Android users and AppGallery for Huawei users. Before taxpayers can access the MyInvois Application on their smartphones, users need to activate their profile via the MyInvois Portal first.
MyInvois Portal provides key features as follows:
Profile Management for User, Taxpayers, Representative, ERP System and Intermediary; and
Document Management includes Submit, View, Reject, Cancel and Print Document.

Taxpayers can access the MyInvois Portal via the MyTax Portal, the gateway of HASiL e-Services. To facilitate the use of the MyInvois Portal, HASiL provides two (2) environments that taxpayers can access, namely the Testing (Sandbox) Environment and Production Environment. Users need to activate each of these environments separately as they are not connected to each other.
[Notes: Taxpayers must ensure to use the correct environment for e-Invoice submission to HASiL]

Allow taxpayers to try the functions provided in the portal before using the actual (production) environment. Information sent to the testing environment will not be stored in the HASiL database and will not be migrated to the production environment.

pages.title: Keperluan Peranan Bagi Mengakses Portal MyInvois
lines: Role Requirement to Access the MyInvois Portal
To access the MyInvois Portal under the name of business / company / organization, user need to apply for a role on the MyTax Portal as follows:
For individual taxpayer who is conducting sole proprietorship business only.
For all categories of taxpayers except individual who is conducting sole proprietorship business and estate administrators (such as Partnership, Company, Cooperative Society, etc.).
The previous Company Director / Organization Administrator must cancel their role before the new Company Director / Organization Administrator can apply.
For Estate Administrator who is managing the estate of deceased persons only.
Appointed by the Business Owner in their MyTax Portal.
Business Owner need to ensure that business information and employer information are in order in the HASiL records before appointing a Business Representative.
Business Owner can appoint and revoke the appointment of representatives at any time as needed.
Appointed by the Company Director / Organization Administrator in their MyTax Portal.
Company Director / Organization Administrator can appoint and revoke the appointment of representatives at any time as needed.
[Note: Taxpayer is required to apply the role to access for Production Environment or Testing Environment separately]

lines: Portal MyInvois adalah mekanisme penghantaran e-Invois yang disediakan khas oleh HASiL secara percuma. Portal ini direka untuk memudahkan pelaksanaan e-Invois kepada semua pembayar cukai, terutamanya kepada mereka yang tidak mempunyai sistem perniagaan untuk mengeluarkan e-Invois. Portal ini boleh diakses melalui komputer, komputer riba dan tablet bagi membolehkan pengguna mengendalikan e-Invois pada bila-bila masa dan di mana jua.

Selain itu, pembayar cukai juga boleh mengakses melalui Aplikasi MyInvois di telefon pintar. Aplikasi boleh dimuat turun daripada semua platform rasmi iaitu App Store bagi pengguna iOS, Google Play bagi pengguna Android dan AppGallery bagi pengguna Huawei. Sebelum pembayar cukai mengakses Aplikasi MyInvois di telefon pintar mereka, pengguna perlu mengaktifkan profil melalui Portal MyInvois terlebih dahulu.
Portal MyInvois menyediakan ciri-ciri utama diperlukan oleh pembayar cukai seperti berikut:
Pengurusan Profil bagi Pengguna, Pembayar Cukai, Wakil, Sistem ERP dan Perantara; dan
Pengurusan Dokumen merangkumi Pengemukaan, Semakan, Penolakan, Pembatalan dan Cetakan Dokumen.

Portal MyInvois boleh diakses oleh pembayar cukai melalui Portal MyTax yang merupakan gerbang e-Perkhidmatan HASiL. Bagi memudahkan penggunaan Portal MyInvois, HASiL menyediakan dua (2) persekitaran yang boleh diakses oleh pembayar cukai iaitu Persekitaran Pengujian dan Persekitaran Sebenar (Produksi). Pengguna perlu mengaktifkan setiap persekitaran ini secara berasingan kerana ia tidak berhubung antara satu sama lain.
[Nota: Pembayar cukai perlu memastikan penggunaan persekitaran yang betul bagi pengemukaan e-Invois kepada HASiL]

Membolehkan pembayar cukai mencuba fungsi-fungsi yang disediakan di dalam portal berkenaan sebelum menggunakan Persekitaran Sebenar (Produksi). Maklumat yang dihantar ke persekitaran pengujian tidak akan disimpan di dalam pangkalan data HASiL dan tidak akan di bawa ke persekitaran produksi.
